text:
Lina (Marketplace): Quick heads-up 3 Keystone Labs reached out asking to list their Nova appliance as a private-offer across AWS/GCP marketplaces. They want a commit-based gating model + short exclusivity and a joint launch plan. Can we align on economics + renewal?
Omar (Partnerships): Do we have the numbers from Keystone? minimum commit / discount / term ask?
Lina (Marketplace): They proposed $200k annual commit to unlock the private SKU, 18% off list for 12 months. They also want 45-day SKU exclusivity in the marketplace and $20k co-marketing.
Priya - HW Alliance: 45 days exclusivity is fine only if paired with a performance milestone (e.g., 10 paid transactions or 50 qualified leads). Otherwise it's gating without value. Also confirm shipping ETA to meet the launch.
Samir (Legal): For exclusivity we'll need a clear milestone and termination if not met. Auto-renew is tricky; suggest opt-out renewal with 60-day notification instead of forced auto-renew. Also require audit rights for usage measurement.
Lina (Marketplace): Proposal from my side: two-tier offer: $200k/12mo @18% or $300k/24mo @24% with exclusivity only on the 24mo option for 45 days; smaller tier gets no exclusivity. Add a first-month onboarding credit of $10k if milestones met.
Omar (Partnerships): That creates an upsell path. Also add a consumption collar: if usage >125% over a 90-day rolling window, we either step pricing up next term or convert to reserved pricing. Keeps cost predictable.
Priya - HW Alliance: Agree. Also insist SKU aliasing: NOVA-ENT-PRV must map to our internal NOVA-ENT meter so billing and usage tracking are identical. Ops?
infra-bot: Private SKU aliasing supported; billing alias entry required. Estimated config lead time = 4 business days after contract countersignature. No infra blockers.
Samir (Legal): For renewal language: opt-out with 60/30/15 day notifications, written opt-out required 15 days before renewal. Dispute process: 30-day remediation window, then arb if unresolved. We'll draft a narrow exclusivity clause with carve-outs for government procurement.
Lina (Marketplace): Co-marketing: Keystone asked for a day-zero joint press announcement + paid campaign. Partnerships can approve up to $15k from the co-marketing pool; anything beyond needs GTM approval. We can commit to a webinar within 30 days and a joint case study if they hit the milestone.
Omar (Partnerships): I'll own negotiation and get GTM sign-off if they push >$15k. Priya, can you confirm shipping SLA and any minimum inventory to support marketplace orders?
Priya - HW Alliance: I'll validate shipping SLA and confirm whether we can meet a public launch date. Also push Keystone to accept milestone requirements for exclusivity.
Samir (Legal): I'll assemble a 1-page term sheet and clause bullets for exclusivity, renewal opt-out windows, usage audit and data handling.
Lina (Marketplace): Thanks. Next steps: I'll drop a draft term sheet with the two-tier pricing, exclusivity-on-longer-term, consumption-collar, and co-marketing caps in drive and schedule a 30-min review. Can folks join 10am PT tomorrow?
Omar (Partnerships): Yes, I'll join.
Priya - HW Alliance: I'll join and bring shipping dates.
Samir (Legal): I'll join and bring the draft clause language.
infra-bot: Calendar invite created for 10:00 PT. Reminder 15m prior.
Lina (Marketplace): Great 2 I'll put the draft up and tag you all. :sparkles:
